title: #353 Important Environment
prompt: Environment is important. It is better for children to grow up in the countryside than in a big city. To what extent do you agree with this statement?

promptSegments.text: It is better for children to grow up in the countryside than in a big city.
To what extent do you agree with this statement?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The countryside is better for children's health because the air is cleaner and there is more space, allowing children to play in green fields and nature, which leads to more exercise and happiness.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The countryside is better for children's health because the air is cleaner and there is more space, allowing children to play in green fields and nature, which leads to more exercise and happiness.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Education is also better in the countryside because schools have a calm setting away from city noise, allowing students to focus and learn better.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Education is also better in the countryside because schools have a calm setting away from city noise, allowing students to focus and learn better.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: City life offers many chances for people to learn and work.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: City life offers many chances for people to learn and work.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: City life also provides better access to shops and services.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: City life also provides better access to shops and services.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Children in rural areas benefit from a cleaner environment, having better access to open spaces and fresh air, which improves their physical health and understanding of nature.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Children in rural areas benefit from a cleaner environment, having better access to open spaces and fresh air, which improves their physical health and understanding of nature.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Country life allows children to develop a strong connection with nature due to its slower pace, leading to patience and a deeper understanding of life cycles.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Country life allows children to develop a strong connection with nature due to its slower pace, leading to patience and a deeper understanding of life cycles.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Rural areas provide a cleaner environment with fresh air and green spaces, which improves children's overall health and physical activity.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Rural areas provide a cleaner environment with fresh air and green spaces, which improves children's overall health and physical activity.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The slower, less crowded lifestyle in the countryside reduces stress, allowing children to develop a calmer temperament and stronger family bonds.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The slower, less crowded lifestyle in the countryside reduces stress, allowing children to develop a calmer temperament and stronger family bonds.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.

modelPlan.focus: Discuss the benefits of rural upbringing over urban for children's development.
keyArguments: Rural environments offer more access to nature and fresh air, promoting physical and mental health.
Urban areas provide educational and cultural amenities but come with challenges like pollution and overcrowding.
